description: For electrical call, this estimate worksheet records hazard screen, diagnostic boundary, outage plan, repair options, parts, permit needs, and price authorization. use_case: Use the estimate worksheet during residential electrical service call dispatch when the electrical call record must identify panel, breaker, circuit, device, symptom, affected loads, occupancy, access, and prior modifications. Complete the applicable handoff for safe re-energization, label correction, customer explanation, permit status, repair warranty, and service record.
